_about: Per-fragment / per-article mode declaration. The gate aggregators (run-gate-a.sh, c-constitution.sh) read this file to decide whether a failing fragment fails the gate (BLOCKING) or only logs (REPORT). Modes change as their owning dispatch lands. See scripts/gates/EXPECTED-FAILURES.md for the human-readable timeline and .ai-coder/governance/GATE-AMENDMENTS.md for the amendment process. This file is the machine-readable source of truth.

a-cross-source-cancellation-policy.rationale: The gate prevents customer display-tier drift across clients. E09 freezes both the display-policy editor and the separate live refund-setting controls; this gate does not certify that the two money-policy sources are unified.

a-cross-source-brand-color.rationale: Bug UX-018 supersedes Bug 1324; mobile theme.ts uses canonical Stitch primary #003D9B.

a-cross-source-routes.rationale: Bug 1185 (static paths) fixed in D02 Part 4. Backtick template-string router calls deferred to D12 per LAUNCH-LIMITATIONS §routes-registry-template-strings.

a-cross-source-tier-criteria.rationale: Bug 1323 fixed; founding tier criteria server-canonical.

a-cross-source-no-axios.rationale: Bug 1271 fixed for clients (admin in D01, mobile in D02 Part 5). Scope: apps/ only — server outbound axios excluded by design.

a-cross-source-no-emoji-icons.rationale: Promoted after the 2026-08-23 UX audit replaced the remaining production emoji iconography with the central vector icon set and the corrected scanner reported zero violations. Future regressions now block CI.

a-cross-source-hashes-immutable.rationale: Preventive: HASHES-CORRECTED.sha256 files (when added) must not be modified. Currently no such files exist; gate is vacuously passing but locks the rule in.

a-cross-source-no-client-money.rationale: Promoted to BLOCKING in D05 (2026-04-30). Bug 175/176/208/1132/261/266/269/320/322/417/1219/1230 closed: every customer-facing validator now uses the server-canonical pattern (clients send IDs and quantities; server resolves prices from DB). Allowed exceptions are documented inline with `// gate-a-allowed:` markers (e.g., admin-defines-promo-value in createPromoCodeSchema) and at the schema-name level (adminWalletAdjustmentSchema, createAddonSchema/updateAddonSchema). Any future PR that introduces `servicePrice: z.number()` (or similar money-from-client) in a Zod validator fails this gate.

a-cross-source-no-siguradoshield.rationale: Promoted to BLOCKING in D04 (Ken's Option A pull, 2026-04-30). Now a thin alias that delegates to gate_c_articles.no-shield-references for actual enforcement. The original REPORT-only fragment scanned apps/ + packages/ tolerantly; the D04 successor enforces strictly with a documented allowlist.

article-4.2-no-console.rationale: Promoted to BLOCKING in D14r-8. Production code uses logger.* throughout (apps/admin/src + apps/mobile/src + apps/mobile/app + packages/api/src); a fresh grep finds 0 console.* violations. The gate now blocks any future regression. Allowed exceptions remain inline `// gate-c-allowed:` markers.

article-4.6-no-emoji.rationale: Redundant defense for Gate A's emoji check. Promoted after the 2026-08-23 zero-violation production scan so either gate blocks a future regression.

article-7.1-no-axios.rationale: Scope corrected in D03 to apps/ only (matches Gate A's a-cross-source-no-axios). Server-to-server outbound axios in packages/api/src/services/{payment,sms}.service.ts is out of scope for this gate.

article-12-bigint-money-tests.rationale: bigint-money-precision.test.ts already exists with 5+ tests (Phase 13 Dispatch E).

article-16-closeout-exists.rationale: Activates per dispatch branch. Always BLOCKING when running on a phase/14-dNN-* branch.

money-in-transaction.rationale: Promoted to BLOCKING in D06 (2026-04-30). Bugs 69, 70, 71, 78, 79, 80, 82, 83, 84, 85, 105, 106, 127, 237 — 14 services closed: every money/audit mutation either composes via a trx-aware *InTransaction helper or is annotated with `// gate-c-allowed: best-effort-audit-only` for the documented non-blocking audit pattern (try/catch + logger.warn so audit failures don't roll back the durable underlying state). Two real bugs adjacent to the 14-list also fixed in this dispatch: dispute.service.assignDispute and payout.service.approvePayout. Gate logic was rewritten in D06 — the prior Kysely-pattern regex was vacuously passing because the codebase uses raw pg; the new awk pattern detects db.query calls with INSERT INTO admin_actions/wallet_transactions or UPDATE wallets at the top level (not inside db.transaction). Allowed exceptions are documented inline with `// gate-c-allowed:` markers.

no-shield-references.rationale: Stricter SiguradoShield gate per Ken's Option A pull (.ai-coder/decisions/D04-siguradoshield.md, 2026-04-30). Replaces the REPORT-only Gate A no-siguradoshield fragment. Blocks any code-line reintroduction of SiguradoShield to UI surfaces or charge/payout code; comments documenting the removal are skipped. Allowlist covers spec docs, deprecated migrations, LAUNCH-LIMITATIONS §23, the decision file, and gate scripts. Implementation: scripts/gates/c-constitution-no-shield-references.sh (run as part of c-constitution.sh aggregator).

gate_d_state.rationale: F#4 admin half is DONE: 354 Playwright baselines (29 pages x 4 states x 3 widths) are committed and validated against a live admin app on 2026-06-10 (348 passed as-is; provider-detail re-captured after legitimate Phase-200-era UI drift: Staff/Disputes/Activity/Notes tabs, Selfie verification row, Service Areas sidebar entry). Promote to BLOCKING when the F#3 mobile half lands: the 84 Maestro flows were nav-less scaffolds with the wrong appId (com.onservice.app vs the real ph.onservice.app) and are being rewritten with real login + deep-link navigation (scripts/maestro/generate-visual-flows.mjs + capture-baselines.sh); capture needs an Android emulator session. See the two handoff docs in .ai-coder/handoff/.

gate_e_state.rationale: Stryker is not currently installed in packages/api/node_modules. Promoting Gate E to BLOCKING requires (1) adding @stryker-mutator/core + @stryker-mutator/jest-runner as devDeps, (2) configuring stryker.conf.cjs with the existing 99% threshold, (3) running a baseline against the full API suite to confirm score, (4) fixing any tests below the threshold. Tracked as a focused R-8b follow-up. Mutation score baseline at 99.3% from Phase 13 partial run.
